newsitem.title: USA: NTL studying options after ITC rejection.
newsitem.headline: NTL studying options after ITC rejection.

text.p: NTL Inc said Tuesday it is considering its options following the Independent Television Commission's announcement that NTL's subsidiary, Digital Television Network, was not awarded a license for digital terrestrial television.
The licenses for each of the three multiplexes were awarded to British Digital Broadcasting, owned jointly by Carlton Communications Plc and Granada Group Plc.
"We are disappointed by the decision," NTL Chief Executive Barclay Knapp said.
"We welcome the fact that the ITC preferred DTN's innovative program plan.
"However, the decision raises continuing and serious concerns in relation to competition and other matters. We will be carefully considering our options."
